topic: angle and length problems with tangents
summary: Tangent at a point on a circle with a diameter drawn; from a given inscribed angle, get the angle between tangent and chord.
template: Tangent at {C}, diameter {AB}, angle {CAB} = {x}; find angle {PCA}.

topic: middle terms and conditions for AP
summary: Three expressions linear in k are successive AP terms; determine k.
template: {expr1}, {expr2}, {expr3} are consecutive AP terms; find k.

topic: heights and distances (single or two angles of elevation/depression)
summary: Ladder against a wall at a known inclination with its foot a known distance away; get the ladder's length.
template: Ladder at {angle} to ground, foot {d} from wall; find length.

summary: One card from a standard deck; chance it is neither of a certain colour nor a certain rank.
template: Draw one card from {52}; probability it is neither {colour} nor {rank}.

topic: value of k for equal roots
summary: A known root fixes p in one quadratic; a second quadratic using p has equal roots, so determine k.
template: {root} is a root of {quadratic in p}; {second quadratic in p, k} has equal roots; find k.

summary: Locate the two points dividing a segment between given endpoints into three equal parts.
template: Trisection points of segment from {A} to {B}; find both coordinates.

topic: circle touching sides of a figure
summary: For a quadrilateral whose four sides touch a circle, show the two pairs of opposite sides have equal sums.
template: Quadrilateral {ABCD} circumscribes a circle; prove {AB+CD = BC+DA}.

summary: Show three given coordinate points form a triangle that is both right angled and isosceles.
template: Show {P1},{P2},{P3} are vertices of a right isosceles triangle.

summary: An AP has one term equal to zero; establish that a later term is a fixed multiple of another term.
template: Term {p} of an AP is 0; prove term {q} = {k} times term {r}.

topic: angle and length problems with tangents
summary: Two tangents from a point whose distance from the centre is twice the radius; show two chord-radius angles have a stated value.
template: Tangents PT, PS with OP = {2r}; prove base angles of triangle OTS equal {angle}.

summary: Semicircle on a known diameter holding a right triangle with one known leg; find the shaded area outside the triangle.
template: Diameter {AB}, chord {AC}, join BC; shaded area = semicircle minus triangle, pi = {value}.

summary: Tent built from a cylinder capped by a cone; canvas area and its cost at a given rate.
template: Cylinder {h, d} topped by cone with slant {l}; canvas cost at {rate} per sq m.

summary: A general point lies equally far from two points written in a and b; derive a linear relation between x and y.
template: P(x,y) equidistant from {A(a,b form)} and {B(a,b form)}; prove {relation}.

summary: Region between two concentric circles excluding a given central-angle sector; compute its area.
template: Concentric radii {r1},{r2}, sector angle {theta}; find the shaded ring area.

summary: Two APs have sums of first n terms in a stated ratio in n; derive the ratio of their mth terms.
template: S_n ratio of two APs = {f(n)}:{g(n)}; find ratio of their mth terms.

summary: Rational equation with products of linear factors in the denominators simplifies to a quadratic; solve it.
template: Solve 1/{(x-a)(x-b)} + 1/{(x-b)(x-c)} = {k}, with excluded values.

summary: Water fills a cone and is poured into a wider cylinder; how high does it stand?
template: Cone {r,h} of water emptied into cylinder of radius {R}; find water height.

summary: A ball sinks fully in a cylinder of water, raising the level by a known amount; work out the cylinder's diameter.
template: Sphere of diameter {d} submerged, level rises {h}; find cylinder diameter.

topic: heights and distances (single or two angles of elevation/depression)
summary: Observer on a ship at known height sees a hill's top and foot at given angles; find hill height and distance.
template: Observer at height {h}, elevation {a} to top, depression {b} to base; find height and distance.

summary: Three coins flipped at once: chances of an exact head count and of two minimum counts.
template: Toss {3} coins; probability of exactly {k} heads, at least {k} heads, at least {k} tails.

summary: Relief tents shaped as cylinder plus cone are funded jointly by schools; find each school's share of canvas cost and comment on values.
template: {n} tents, cylinder {r,h} plus cone height {H}, canvas {rate}; share among {m} schools.

summary: Prove the standard theorem about the two tangent segments from an outside point having the same length.
template: Theorem: from an outside point {P}, both tangent segments to a circle match in length.

topic: NEW: tangents inclined at a given angle
summary: Draw a circle of given radius and construct a pair of tangents meeting at a specified angle.
template: Circle radius {r}; construct two tangents inclined at {angle}.

summary: Equal circles touching externally, tangent from an extended centre line, perpendicular from the nearer centre; find a length ratio by similarity.
template: Equal touching circles, tangent AC, O'D perpendicular to AC; find {DO'/CO}.

summary: Equation with three reciprocal-linear terms clears to a quadratic; solve under the stated exclusions.

topic: heights and distances (single or two angles of elevation/depression)
summary: Tower top viewed from a ground point and from a point directly above it, at different angles; find height and ground distance.
template: Elevation {a} from X, {b} from Y which is {h} above X; find tower height and PX.

summary: Numbered houses along a row: show one house exists where numbers before it total the same as numbers after it.
template: Houses 1 to {n}; show an X exists with sum before X = sum after X.

summary: Triangle from coordinates with a segment cutting two sides in a fixed proportion; find the small triangle's area and compare.
template: Vertices {A,B,C}; D,E on AB,AC with ratio {1/k}; compare areas of ADE and ABC.

summary: Pick one number from each of two small lists; chance their product stays under a limit.
template: x from {list1}, y from {list2}; probability that xy < {n}.

summary: Perpendicular at a radius's end meets the extended other radius of a sector; derive the shaded boundary length in r and theta.
template: Sector angle {theta}, radius {r}, AB perpendicular to OA; prove perimeter = {expression}.

summary: Boat with known still-water speed takes an extra hour against the current on a fixed trip; find the current's speed.
template: Boat speed {v}, distance {d}, upstream takes {t} longer; find stream speed.
